name: Haney's Appledale Farm
description: In Nancy, KY, Haney's Appledale Farm raises Apples, Pears, Peaches, Nectarines, and Pumpkins on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn and summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
